model_names: [Bundle of 4] Holistic Way Non-Acidic Buffered Vitamin-C 1000mg - Vegetarian (60 Tablets x 4)
description:
MAHS number: MAHS2100026

Holistic Way Non-Acidic Buffered Vitamin-C 1000mg is a unique formulation that combines calcium ascorbate and mixed bioflavonoids to promote the absorption and effects of Vitamin-C in the body. Vitamin-C is an important antioxidant that supports healthy immune system functioning and stimulates collagen growth.

What sets this supplement apart is its non-acidic formula, which is gentler on the stomach than traditional Vitamin-C supplements. Additionally, it is enriched with Vitamin D and Zinc, which further promote the maintenance of healthy capillaries, skin, bones, gums, and teeth. This antioxidant formulation supports wound healing and acts as a free radical scavenger in the body.

By supporting the body's natural defenses and promoting overall health, Holistic Way Non-Acidic Buffered Vitamin-C 1000mg is an excellent choice for those seeking a gentler Vitamin-C supplement that delivers powerful benefits.

Pack Size: 
• 60 Tablets

Recommended Dosage
Take 1 tablet daily, or as recommended by a physician. 

Ingredients
• Vitamin C (Calcium Ascorbate) — 1000mg
• Calcium (Calcium Ascorbate) — 100mg
• Zinc (Zinc Oxide) — 9mg
• Vitamin D (Cholecalciferol) — 400IU
• Hesperidin — 20mg
• Rutin — 20mg
• Rosehip — 20mg

No Added
• Wheat, gluten, yeast, soy, milk, nuts, eggs, fish, artificial flavours or preservatives. 
• Suitable for vegetarians / vegans.

Caution
Keep out of reach of children. Store below 30°C in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening for maximum potency.
